verdict.rationale: Ardent is Postgres database-branching infrastructure, so asking whether it supports storing embeddings and running vector similarity search natively is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions embeddings, vector types, pgvector or similarity search; the docs cover only cloning, branching, migrations and agent workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store embeddings and run vector similarity search natively without adding a separate vector database
